title: Monster Speed V3 Step 6 — Permanent hot dependency + browser cache
root_cause: The shared browser cache was prebuilt, but its identity still came from unpinned dependency intent plus a manual cache epoch. A cache miss could therefore resolve a different Python environment than the key represented, and non-dependency cache controls could invalidate an otherwise reusable stack.
patch: Commit exact root and browser locks, key the active shared browser cache only from OS/Python plus those exact locks, install the exact browser lock on misses, keep a main cache seed, and require a second-job real cache hit with cached Chromium launch before freezing.
